effect.long: fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

flavor: The user becomes soaked to raise resistance to fire.

name: calm-mind

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

flavor: Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF by focusing the mind.

name: leaf-blade

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: Slashes with a sharp leaf. High critical-hit ratio.

name: dragon-dance

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

flavor: A mystical dance that ups ATTACK and SPEED.

name: rock-blast

effect.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

flavor: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.

name: shock-wave

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor: A fast and unavoidable electric attack.

name: doom-desire

effect.short: Hits the target two turns later.
effect.long:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one.  This move cannot score a critical hit.  If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead.  Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted.  No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through wonder guard.

If the target is protected by protect or detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail.  However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores endure and focus sash.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.

flavor: Summons strong sunlight to attack 2 turns later.

name: psycho-boost

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.

name: roost

effect.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.long: Heals the user for half its max HP.  If the user is flying, its flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

flavor: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

name: gravity

effect.short: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
effect.long:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to ground moves are disabled.  For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages.  Cancels the effects of bounce, fly, and sky drop.

Specifically, flying Pokémon and those with levitate or that have used magnet rise are no longer immune to ground attacks, arena trap, spikes, or toxic spikes.

bounce, fly, sky drop, high jump kick, jump kick, and splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of sky drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

flavor: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

name: miracle-eye

effect.short: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
effect.long: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field.  A dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from psychic moves.  This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

name: wake-up-slap

effect.short: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

flavor: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.

name: hammer-arm

effect.short: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

flavor: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

name: gyro-ball

effect.short: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

flavor: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

name: healing-wish

effect.short: User faints.  Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
effect.long: User faints.  Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.  If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

flavor: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

name: brine

effect.short: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

flavor: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

name: natural-gift

effect.short: Power and type depend on the held berry.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry.  The berry is consumed.  If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

flavor: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

name: feint

effect.short: Hits through Protect and Detect.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the effects of detect or protect from the target before hitting.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.

flavor: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

name: pluck

effect.short: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

flavor: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

name: tailwind

effect.short: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
effect.long: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled.  This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

flavor: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

name: acupressure

effect.short: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
effect.long:
Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages.  The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages.  If no stat is eligible, this move will fail.

If the target has a substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.

flavor: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

name: metal-burst

effect.short: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
effect.long: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn.  Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

flavor: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.

name: u-turn

effect.short: User must switch out after attacking.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of ingrain.  ingrain’s effect will end.

flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: close-combat

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

flavor: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

name: payback

effect.short: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

flavor: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

name: assurance

effect.short: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

flavor: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

name: embargo

effect.short: Target cannot use held items.
effect.long:
Target cannot use its held item for five turns.  If the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If a Pokémon under this effect uses bug bite or pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used.  If a Pokémon under this effect uses fling, it will fail.

This effect is passed by baton pass.

flavor: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

name: fling

effect.short: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s held item.  The item is consumed.  If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.

This move ignores sticky hold.

If the user is under the effect of embargo, this move will fail.

flavor: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

name: psycho-shift

effect.short: Transfers the user’s major status effect to the target.
effect.long: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.

flavor: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

name: trump-card

effect.short: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

PP remaining | Power
------------ | ----:
4 or more    |    40
3            |    50
2            |    60
1            |    80
0            |   200

If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

flavor: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.

name: heal-block

effect.short: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.
effect.long: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled.  Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.

flavor: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

name: wring-out

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

flavor: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

name: power-trick

effect.short: User swaps Attack and Defense.
effect.long:
The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

name: gastro-acid

effect.short: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.
effect.long:
The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.

flavor: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

name: lucky-chant

effect.short: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.
effect.long: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.

flavor: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

name: me-first

effect.short: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
effect.long:
If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power.

If the target moves before the user, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.

flavor: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

name: copycat

effect.short: Uses the target’s last used move.
effect.long:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.

This move cannot copy itself, nor roar nor whirlwind.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.

flavor: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

name: power-swap

effect.short: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.
effect.long: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.

name: guard-swap

effect.short: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.
effect.long: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.

name: punishment

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200.  Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

flavor: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

name: last-resort

effect.short: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field.  If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

flavor: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

name: worry-seed

effect.short: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
effect.long:
Changes the target’s ability to insomnia.

If the target’s ability is truant or multitype, this move will fail.

flavor: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

name: sucker-punch

effect.short: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

This move is not affected by iron fist.

flavor: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

name: toxic-spikes

effect.short: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
effect.long:
Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field.  A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead.  Pokémon immune to either ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect.  Pokémon otherwise immune to ground moves are affected during gravity.

If a poison Pokémon not immune to ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.

rapid spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field.  defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field.

This move does not trigger synchronize, unless the Pokémon with synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as roar.

Pokémon entering the field due to baton pass are not affected by this effect.

flavor: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

name: heart-swap

effect.short: User and target swap stat changes.
effect.long: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.

name: aqua-ring

effect.short: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.
effect.long:
Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.

flavor: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

name: magnet-rise

effect.short: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
effect.long:
For five turns, the user is immune to ground moves.

If the user is under the effect of ingrain or has levitate, this move will fail.

This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during gravity.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.

flavor: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

name: aura-sphere

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

name: rock-polish

effect.short: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

flavor: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

name: night-slash

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: aqua-tail

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

name: seed-bomb

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

name: x-scissor

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: dragon-pulse

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

name: power-gem

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

name: drain-punch

effect.short: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

flavor: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: vacuum-wave

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

name: brave-bird

effect.short: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

flavor: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

name: switcheroo

effect.short: User and target swap items.
effect.long:
User and target permanently swap held items.  Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything.  If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has multitype or sticky hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining choice band, choice scarf, or choice specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move.  This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used.  If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with recycle.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.

flavor: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

name: giga-impact

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: nasty-plot

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

name: bullet-punch

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

name: avalanche

effect.short: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

pain split does not count as damaging the user.

flavor: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

name: ice-shard

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

name: shadow-claw

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: shadow-sneak

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.

name: psycho-cut

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: defog

effect.short: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.  Removes field effects from the enemy field.
effect.long:
Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.  Clears away fog.  Removes the effects of mist, light screen, reflect, safeguard, spikes, stealth rock, and toxic spikes from the target’s side of the field.

If the target is protected by mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

flavor: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

name: trick-room

effect.short: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
effect.long:
For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.  Move priority is not affected.  Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect.

Pokémon holding full incense, lagging tail, or quick claw and Pokémon with stall ignore this effect.

flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: draco-meteor

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: leaf-storm

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: power-whip

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

name: rock-wrecker

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

name: magnet-bomb

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.

name: stone-edge

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: captivate

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages if it’s the opposite gender.
effect.long: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.  If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

flavor: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

name: stealth-rock

effect.short: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
effect.long:
Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP.  This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to rock moves.

rapid spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

flavor: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

name: grass-knot

effect.short: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power
--------------- | ----:
Up to 10kg      |    20
Up to 25kg      |    40
Up to 50kg      |    60
Up to 100kg     |    80
Up to 200kg     |   100
Above 200kg     |   120

flavor: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

name: chatter

effect.short: Has a higher chance to confuse the target when the recorded sound is louder.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion.  If the user is not a chatot, this move will not cause confusion.

This move cannot be copied by mimic, mirror move, or sketch, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.

flavor: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.

name: judgment

effect.short: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both techno blast and judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

flavor: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

name: bug-bite

effect.short: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

flavor: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

name: wood-hammer

effect.short: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

flavor: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

name: aqua-jet

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

name: attack-order

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

name: defend-order

effect.short: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

flavor: The user calls out its underlings to make a living shield, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: heal-order

effect.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.long: Heals the user for half its max HP.

flavor: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

name: head-smash

effect.short: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

flavor: The user delivers a life-endangering head butt at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.

name: double-hit

effect.short: Hits twice in one turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.

flavor: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

name: roar-of-time

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: spacial-rend

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: lunar-dance

effect.short: User faints, and its replacement is fully healed.
effect.long: User faints.  Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.

flavor: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

name: crush-grip

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

flavor: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.

name: magma-storm

effect.short: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

rapid spin cancels this effect.

flavor: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.

name: dark-void

effect.short: Puts the target to sleep.
effect.long: Puts the target to sleep.

flavor: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.

name: shadow-force

effect.short: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.  Hits through Protect and Detect.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

This move ignores the effects of detect and protect.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

flavor: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.

name: hone-claws

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage.

flavor: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

name: wide-guard

effect.short: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
effect.long:
Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.

flavor: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

name: guard-split

effect.short: Averages Defense and Special Defense with the target.
effect.long: Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.

name: power-split

effect.short: Averages Attack and Special Attack with the target.
effect.long:
Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way.

This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as flower gift during sunny day.

flavor: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target’s.

name: wonder-room

effect.short: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.
effect.long: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.

flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

name: psyshock

effect.short: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

flavor: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: venoshock

effect.short: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

flavor: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

name: autotomize

effect.short: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages and halves the user’s weight.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.  Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.

flavor: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

name: rage-powder

effect.short: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
effect.long:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user.  If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over lightning rod and storm drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.

flavor: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

name: telekinesis

effect.short: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.
effect.long:
For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to ground damage.  Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect.

This effect is removed by gravity.  If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.

flavor: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

name: magic-room

effect.short: Negates held items for five turns.
effect.long: For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items.

flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

name: smack-down

effect.short: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the target’s immunity to ground-type damage.  This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to levitate, magnet rise, or telekinesis, and causes the target’s flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage.

If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

flavor: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

name: storm-throw

effect.short: Always scores a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Always scores a critical hit.

flavor: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

name: flame-burst

effect.short: Deals splash damage to Pokémon next to the target.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If this move successfully hits the target, any Pokémon adjacent to the target are damaged for 1/16 their max HP.

flavor: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

name: quiver-dance

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

flavor: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

name: heavy-slam

effect.short: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120.

User’s weight                    | Power
-------------------------------- | ----:
Up to 2× the target’s weight     |    40
Up to 3× the target’s weight     |    60
Up to 4× the target’s weight     |    80
Up to 5× the target’s weight     |   100
More than 5× the target’s weight |   120

flavor: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

name: synchronoise

effect.short: Hits any Pokémon that shares a type with the user.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Only Pokémon that share a type with the user will take damage from this move.

flavor: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.

name: electro-ball

effect.short: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150.

User’s Speed                     | Power
-------------------------------- | ----:
Up to 2× the target’s Speed      |    60
Up to 3× the target’s Speed      |    80
Up to 4× the target’s Speed      |   120
More than 4× the target’s Speed  |   150

flavor: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

name: soak

effect.short: Changes the target’s type to Water.
effect.long: Changes the target to pure water-type until it leaves the field.  If the target has multitype, this move will fail.

flavor: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.

name: flame-charge

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

flavor: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

name: coil

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

flavor: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

name: low-sweep

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.long: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

flavor: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

name: acid-spray

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

flavor: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: foul-play

effect.short: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s.

flavor: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.

name: simple-beam

effect.short: Changes the target’s ability to Simple.
effect.long: Changes the target’s ability to simple.

flavor: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

name: entrainment

effect.short: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
effect.long: Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s.  This effect ends when the target leaves battle.

flavor: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

name: after-you

effect.short: Makes the target act next this turn.
effect.long:
The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority.
If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

flavor: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

name: round

effect.short: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled.  After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority.  Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

flavor: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

name: echoed-voice

effect.short: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If any friendly Pokémon used this move earlier this turn or on the previous turn, that use’s power is added to this move’s power, to a maximum of 200.

flavor: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

name: chip-away

effect.short: Ignores the target’s stat modifiers.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

flavor: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

name: clear-smog

effect.short: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero.

flavor: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

name: stored-power

effect.short: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised.  Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power.  For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

flavor: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.

name: quick-guard

effect.short: Prevents any priority moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
effect.long:
Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.

flavor: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

name: ally-switch

effect.short: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
effect.long: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.  If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

flavor: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

name: shell-smash

effect.short: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages.  Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each.  Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

flavor: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

name: heal-pulse

effect.short: Heals the target for half its max HP.
effect.long: Heals the target for half its max HP.

flavor: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

name: hex

effect.short: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

flavor: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

name: sky-drop

effect.short: Carries the target high into the air, dodging all attacks against either, and drops it next turn.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act.  On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect.

If the target is flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage.

gust, hurricane, sky uppercut, smack down, thunder, twister, and whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect.  gust and twister will additionally have double power.

The damage from hail and sandstorm still applies during this effect.

Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be used while gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

*Bug*: If gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

flavor: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

name: shift-gear

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

flavor: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

name: circle-throw

effect.short: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of ingrain or suction cups, or it has a substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out.  If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

name: incinerate

effect.short: Destroys the target’s held berry.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move.

flavor: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

name: quash

effect.short: Makes the target act last this turn.
effect.long: Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority.  If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

flavor: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

name: acrobatics

effect.short: Has double power if the user has no held item.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

flavor: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

name: reflect-type

effect.short: User becomes the target’s type.
effect.long: User’s type changes to match the target’s.

flavor: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.

name: retaliate

effect.short: Has double power if a friendly Pokémon fainted last turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon fainted on the previous turn, this move has double power.

flavor: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

name: final-gambit

effect.short: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP.  User faints.
effect.long: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP.  User faints.

flavor: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.

name: bestow

effect.short: Gives the user’s held item to the target.
effect.long: Transfers the user’s held item to the target.  If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail.

flavor: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.

name: water-pledge

effect.short: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used grass pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).

flavor: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.

name: fire-pledge

effect.short: With Water Pledge, doubles the effect chance of friendly Pokémon’s moves for four turns.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used water pledge earlier this turn, moves used by any friendly Pokémon have doubled effect chance for four turns (including this one).

flavor: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.

name: grass-pledge

effect.short: With Fire Pledge, damages opposing Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP every turn for four turns.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used fire pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon will take 1/8 their max HP in damage at the end of every turn for four turns (including this one).

flavor: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

name: volt-switch

effect.short: User must switch out after attacking.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of ingrain.  ingrain’s effect will end.

flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: frost-breath

effect.short: Always scores a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Always scores a critical hit.

flavor: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

name: dragon-tail

effect.short: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of ingrain or suction cups, or it has a substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out.  If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

flavor: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: work-up

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

flavor: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

name: electroweb

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.long: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

name: drill-run

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

name: dual-chop

effect.short: Hits twice in one turn.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.

name: horn-leech

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

effect.short: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.

Inflicts regular damage.  The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120.

User’s weight                    | Power
-------------------------------- | ----:
Up to 2× the target’s weight     |    40
Up to 3× the target’s weight     |    60
Up to 4× the target’s weight     |    80
Up to 5× the target’s weight     |   100
More than 5× the target’s weight |   120

flavor: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.

name: cotton-guard

effect.short: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
effect.long: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.

flavor: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.

effect.short: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

name: gear-grind

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.

flavor: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

flavor: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

effect.short: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.

name: fusion-flare

effect.short: With Fusion Bolt, inflicts double damage.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used fusion bolt earlier this turn, this move has double power.

flavor: The user brings down a giant flame. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  If a friendly Pokémon used fusion flare earlier this turn, this move has double power.

If the target has used minimize since entering battle, this move has double power and will never miss.

flavor: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

name: mat-block

effect.short: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves.  Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.
effect.long: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves.  Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.

flavor: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.

name: belch

effect.short: Can only be used after the user has eaten a berry.

After the user eats a berry, it may use this move any number of times until the end of the battle, even if it switches out.  Eating a held berry, eating a berry via bug bite or pluck, or being the target of a Flung berry will enable this move.  Feeding a Pokémon a berry from the bag or using natural gift will not.

name: rototiller

effect.short: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grass Pokémon in battle.
effect.long: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grass Pokémon in battle.

effect.long:
Shoots a web over the opponents’ side of the field, which lowers the Speed of any opposing Pokémon that enters the field by one stage.

Pokémon in the air, such as flying-types and those with levitate, are unaffected.  rapid spin removes Sticky Web from the user’s side of the field; defog removes it from both sides.

flavor: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stat upon switching into battle.

name: fell-stinger

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.

flavor: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises sharply.

Inflicts regular damage.  User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

This move ignores the effects of detect and protect.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

flavor: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: trick-or-treat

effect.short: Adds ghost to the target’s types.
effect.long: Adds ghost to the target’s types.

flavor: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.

name: noble-roar

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
effect.long: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.

flavor: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

name: ion-deluge

effect.long: Changes all Pokémon’s normal moves to electric moves for the rest of the turn.

name: parabolic-charge

effect.long: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.

effect.long: Adds grass to the target’s types.

name: petal-blizzard

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

name: freeze-dry

effect.long:
Inflicts regular damage.  This move is super-effective against the water type.

The target’s other type will affect damage as usual.  If this move’s type is changed, it remains super-effective against Water regardless of its type.

flavor: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.

name: disarming-voice

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion.

flavor: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

name: parting-shot

effect.short: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage.  Makes the user switch out.
effect.long: Lowers all targets’ Attack and Special Attack by one stage.  Makes the user switch out.

flavor: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches with a party Pokémon.

name: topsy-turvy

effect.short: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.
effect.long: Inverts the target’s stat modifiers.

flavor: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

name: draining-kiss

effect.short: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.long: Deals regular damage.  Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

flavor: The user steals the target’s energy with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

name: crafty-shield

effect.short: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves.
effect.long:
Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn.

Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.

flavor: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.

name: flower-shield

effect.short: Raises the Defense of all grass Pokémon in battle.
effect.long: Raises the Defense of all grass Pokémon in battle.

flavor: The user raises the Defense stat of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

name: grassy-terrain

effect.long:
For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their grass moves to 1.5× their power.

Changes nature power to energy ball.

flavor: The user turns the ground under everyone’s feet to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn.

effect.short: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion, and halves the power of incoming dragon moves.
effect.long:
For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power.

Changes nature power to moonblast.

flavor: The user covers the ground under everyone’s feet with mist for five turns. This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions.

name: electrify

effect.short: Changes the target’s move’s type to electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.
effect.long: Changes the target’s move’s type to electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.

flavor: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.

name: fairy-wind

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

name: boomburst

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.

effect.short: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.
effect.long: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.

flavor: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

effect.long: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

name: play-nice

effect.long: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

effect.long: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.

flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker who makes direct contact.

effect.long: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.

effect.long: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.

effect.long: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.

name: powder

effect.long: Explodes if the target uses a fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.

flavor: The user covers the target in a powder that explodes and damages the target if it uses a Fire-type move.

effect.long: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.

effect.long: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with plus or minus by one stage.

effect.long:

effect.long:

effect.long: Inflicts regular damage.
